description: Creates a custom vocabulary that you can use to improve the transcription accuracy of domain-specific words and phrases.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the custom vocabulary.
Arn.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the custom vocabulary.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 1011  
Pattern: ^arn:aws(-[^:]+)?:transcribe:[a-zA-Z0-9-]*:[0-9]{12}:[a-zA-Z-]*/[0-9a-zA-Z._-]+$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

VocabularyName.description: A unique name, chosen by you, for your custom vocabulary. This name is case sensitive, cannot contain spaces, and must be unique within an AWS account.
VocabularyName.markdownDescription:
A unique name, chosen by you, for your custom vocabulary. This name is case sensitive, cannot contain spaces, and must be unique within an AWS account.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 200  
Pattern: ^[0-9a-zA-Z._-]+$  
Update requires: Replacement

LanguageCode.description: The language code that represents the language of the entries in your custom vocabulary. Each custom vocabulary must contain terms in only one language.
LanguageCode.markdownDescription:
The language code that represents the language of the entries in your custom vocabulary. Each custom vocabulary must contain terms in only one language.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String  
Update requires: Replacement

Phrases.description: Use this parameter if you want to create your custom vocabulary by including all desired terms, as comma-separated values, within your request. You cannot use this parameter together with VocabularyFileUri.

items.markdownDescription:
---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Maximum Length: 256  
Pattern: ^.+$  
Update requires: No interruption

Phrases.markdownDescription:
Use this parameter if you want to create your custom vocabulary by including all desired terms, as comma-separated values, within your request. You cannot use this parameter together with VocabularyFileUri.

---

Required: No  
Type: Array  
Update requires: No interruption

VocabularyFileUri.description: The Amazon S3 location of the text file that contains your custom vocabulary. You cannot use this parameter together with Phrases.
VocabularyFileUri.markdownDescription:
The Amazon S3 location of the text file that contains your custom vocabulary. You cannot use this parameter together with Phrases.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 2000  
Pattern: ^(s3://|http(s*)://).+$  
Update requires: No interruption

DataAccessRoleArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of an IAM role that has permissions to access the Amazon S3 bucket that contains your input file.
DataAccessRoleArn.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of an IAM role that has permissions to access the Amazon S3 bucket that contains your input file.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 20  
Maximum Length: 2048  
Pattern: ^arn:(aws|aws-cn|aws-us-gov|aws-iso-{0,1}[a-z]{0,1}):iam::[0-9]{0,63}:role/[A-Za-z0-9:_/+=,@.-]{0,1024}$  
Update requires: No interruption

VocabularyState.description: The processing state of your custom vocabulary. If the state is READY, you can use the custom vocabulary in a StartTranscriptionJob request.
VocabularyState.markdownDescription:
The processing state of your custom vocabulary. If the state is READY, you can use the custom vocabulary in a StartTranscriptionJob request.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: PENDING | READY | FAILED  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes
